title: Bundles under 1,000 sats could not be bought
impact: The 600-sat bundles (DeepSeek V4 Flash, GLM 5.3 Flash) failed: the wallet refused to receive less than 1,000 sats. Larger bundles and paid credentials kept working.
fix: Cheapest bundles moved to exactly 1,000 sats for 1,000,000 tokens (same price per token). Added an alert that fires within 5 minutes if invoices can't be created.
